facts.statement: Shanyangosaurus is a genus of theropod dinosaur.
facts.quote: Shanyangosaurus (meaning "Shanyang lizard") is a genus of theropod dinosaur

facts.statement: Shanyangosaurus fossils were found in Shaanxi, China.
The known remains of Shanyangosaurus consist of a partial sacrum, scapula, humeri, femur, tibia, metatarsals, and phalanges.
facts.quote: known only from a partial sacrum, partial scapula, humeri, femur, tibia, metatarsals, and phalanges

facts.statement: Shanyangosaurus lived during the Maastrichtian age in the Shanyang Formation.
facts.quote: found in the Maastrichtian aged Shanyang Formation

facts.statement: The bones of Shanyangosaurus are reportedly hollow.
Features of the femur and foot bones suggest Shanyangosaurus was a member of the Coelurosauria.
facts.quote: this, along with other features of the femur and known foot bones, suggest it is a member of the coelurosauria

facts.statement: Holtz et al. assigned Shanyangosaurus to the Avetheropoda.
facts.quote: Holtz et al. assigned Shanyangosaurus to Avetheropoda

facts.statement: The parent group of Shanyangosaurus is Avetheropoda.
Shanyangosaurus lived between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Shanyangosaurus was described by Xue et al. in 1996.
